added_requirements: Simple date sub-language provides UTC wall-clock formatting
Unsupported date patterns are rejected at compile time

spec_decision.modified_requirement: Template slots parse bounded expressions and unknown languages fail at evaluation — now carries the date: reservation; all six canonical scenarios preserved verbatim plus the reserved-prefix scenario
spec_decision.minijinja_decision: No wall clock in templates: no now function/filter/context value registered; routes compute time with Simple date: or Rhai now_ms() and pass it as header/property; sandbox surface unchanged. Documented in docs/src/languages/minijinja.md, crate docs, and pinned by template_now_function_is_not_registered.
spec_decision.rhai_decision: now_ms() always registered on every engine surface (create_base_engine), opt-in at the call site; returns i64 (outbound-storable, unlike timestamp() whose Instant is refused); NTP step-backward documented; timestamp() monotonic semantics unchanged. No config plumbing; existing scripts gain no nondeterminism.
spec_decision.adr_note: ADR-0092 amended in place (status: Accepted (amended 2026-10-31)): date: is the sanctioned Simple clock surface, now() stays a parse error, the 'clock access forces rhai' list now reads beyond date:/now_ms. Original ADR body untouched.
